title: Safety Moment: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: Session leaders: supervisors and trainers giving a ten-minute safety moment
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: A joint you opened is not proven until its leak test is recorded.

items.text: A pump was restarted after a seal change without a leak test, and the seal leaked [FND-0001; EVD-0001]. The work order had no line for the test [FND-0002].
The gas alarm on that pump only showed on a panel; it did not stop anything [FND-0004].
Ask for the signed leak-test record before any restart.
Check the new seal against the specification on the work order.

items.question: Which job on our unit ends without a test we can show?
items.why: The restart went ahead with no recorded test [FND-0001].
items.answer: Any job that opens a pressure joint should end with a recorded leak test.

items.question: What does our gas alarm do when it sounds?
